name: Team roster
purpose: A dense 3-column list of every team member, each row an indexed name + title linking out. The /about 'Team' section.
structuralNote: Each row is a 56px-tall link with the name and a zero-padded index (001, 002...) on the top line and the title plus a 10px arrow on the bottom line. The index is derived from position, not authored.
assetPolicy: This section carries NO portraits — it is text only. Do not add employee photographs to it.
